abilities.name: Radiant Dash
abilities.description: Jump to an ally or enemy. Enemies are immediately hit with a Basic Attack. Stores up to 2 charges.; 12 / 0.25

fields.notes: Can target all non-Structure units. The Basic Attack from Radiant Dash can trigger attack modifiers, such as Kharazim's Trait, but does not activate Deadly Reach.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Movement Speed bonus

abilities.name: Deadly Reach
abilities.description: Kharazim's next Basic Attack increases his Attack Speed and Attack Range by 100% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Seven-Sided Strike
abilities.description: Become Invulnerable and strike 7 times over 1.6875 seconds. Each strike hits the highest Health nearby Hero for 7% of their maximum Health.; 50; 77; heroic

fields.type: Spell damage / Spell damage / Status effect
fields.props: Area of Effect, Percent damage, Invulnerable
fields.notes: First hit is instant, then every 0.25 seconds the last 6 hits activate. After the 7 hits there is a 0.1875 second delay before he exits. Kharazim is Invulnerable for the duration of the Ability. During this Kharazim is removed from the ground plane, allowing him to disjoint certain projectiles. Deals Percent damage to Heroes and special Spell Damage to Vehicles. Damage dealt to Heroes still ignores all damage modifications, but the damage dealt to Vehicles only ignores offensive damage modifiers and can still be affected by defensive damage modifiers, like Armor, on the target. Can only hit visible enemy Heroes.

talents.name: Transcendence
talents.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack heals the lowest nearby allied Hero for 104 and gives 25% increased Move Speed for 2.5 seconds.

talents.name: Iron Fists
talents.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack deals 110% bonus damage and gives 25% increased Move Speed for 2.5 seconds.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Kharazim's Basic Attack damage.

_raw_fields: Every 3rd Basic Attack deals 110% bonus damage and gives 25% increased Move Speed for 2.5 seconds.

talents.name: Insight
talents.description: quest Every 3rd Basic Attack restores 14 Mana, grants a stack of Insight, and gives 25% increased Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds. Upon getting 100 stacks of Insight, every 3rd attack also reduces Basic Ability cooldowns by 1.75 seconds.

fields.notes: Does not stack with other positive Spell Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

talents.description: While Stunned or Rooted, gain 75 Physical Armor against Hero Basic Attacks for 4 seconds, reducing their damage by 75%.

fields.notes: Duration starts counting down after the Stun or Root expires. Does not stack with other positive Physical Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

talents.name: Way of the Hundred Fists
talents.description: Radiant Dashing to an enemy launches a rapid volley of 6 Basic Attacks dealing 45% damage each.

fields.notes: The Basic Attacks from Way of the Hundred Fists can trigger attack modifiers, such as Kharazim's Trait, but do not trigger an activated Deadly Reach. Casting a Basic or Heroic Ability other than Deadly Reach interrupts the channel, but casting Active Abilities does not. The damage penalty stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting Kharazim's Basic Attack damage.

_raw_fields: Radiant Dashing to an enemy launches a rapid volley of 6 Basic Attacks dealing 45% damage each.

talents.name: Echo of Heaven
talents.description: Breath of Heaven heals 75% of its normal amount, but heals a second time 3 seconds later.

fields.notes: Reduction is applied on both instances of healing. The reduction stacks additively with healing modifiers that affect Breath of Heaven 's healing output and multiplicatively with modifiers that affect healing received.

_raw_fields: Breath of Heaven heals 75% of its normal amount, but heals a second time 3 seconds later.

talents.name: Peaceful Repose
talents.description: Divine Palm's healing amount is increased by 75%, and its cooldown is set to 5 seconds if the Hero does not die.

fields.notes: The bonus healing stacks additively with healing modifiers that affect Divine Palm 's healing output and multiplicatively with modifiers that affect healing received.

_raw_fields: Divine Palm's healing amount is increased by 75%, and its cooldown is set to 5 seconds if the Hero does not die.

talents.name: Transgression
talents.description: Seven-Sided Strike hits 4 additional times.

talents.name: Fists of Legend
talents.description: Gain 50% of the benefit from both level 1 Talents that were not chosen.

fields.notes: Transcendence is applied with a 50% healing dealt reduction to the original value. This reduction stacks additively with other healing dealt modifiers that can affect Transcendence 's healing. Iron Fists applies a 55% damage bonus to the strike that triggers it. This bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Kharazim's Basic Attack damage. Insight 's Mana restoration is reduced to 7 Mana and cooldown reduction to 0.8175 seconds. Completing the quest is not required to gain the cooldown reduction when Insight is gained through Fists of Legend.

_raw_fields: Gain 50% of the benefit from both level 1 Talents that were not chosen.
